items.t: Heavy rain visible outside, nobody has gone out yet.
Snow on shoulders, just in from outside, melting.
A heatwave. Windows open, fan pointing at the wrong person.
Wind. Everything loose is in the air, a door is about to slam.
Early morning, nobody is dressed, one person is fully dressed.
Late night, one lamp, the rest of the house dark.
Mid afternoon slump. Nothing is happening and it is being felt.
A bank holiday. Nothing is open. This was not planned for.
The first warm day. Everyone has overestimated it.
Fog. Only the nearest person is fully visible.
A dark winter afternoon that feels like night at four.
